Initial release of go-coolify skill.

- Guides integration of the unofficial, generated Go client for the Coolify API.
- Supports operations on applications, deployments, databases, services, projects, servers, and teams.
- Includes setup, authentication, and security best practices.
- Explains when and when not to use the package.
- Requires Go toolchain and user-provided API credentials via environment variables.
- Provides permissions information for filesystem, shell, and network access.
